response.sql: WITH lab_ratios AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, l.WBC, CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT != 0 THEN l.HGB / l.HCT ELSE NULL END AS ratio FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID), patient_stats AS (SELECT ID, SEX, AVG(WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM lab_ratios GROUP BY ID, SEX), mean_ratio_cte AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_stats), filtered_patients AS (SELECT ps.ID, ps.SEX, ps.avg_wbc, ps.avg_ratio, (ps.avg_ratio - mr.mean_ratio) AS gap FROM patient_stats ps CROSS JOIN mean_ratio_cte mr WHERE ps.avg_ratio > mr.mean_ratio) SELECT ID, SEX, avg_wbc, avg_ratio, gap FROM filtered_patients ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
